answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to costly admission proof-of-work plus graded original answers each epoch. A newcomer must crack a basalt-hard hash before registering, then publish fresh text peers score for real mechanism—not templates. Rewards vest slowly, so throwaway farms never reach an ivory payout fast enough to repay the oasis of rented compute. Marginal attack cost rises per head while honest agents reuse one established seat.
